inputs.text: flat top-down video game map seen from directly above, orthographic, filling the entire image edge to edge with no border: a patch of a farming valley with soft muted sage-green meadow grass (not lime, not neon) with a few tiny cream wildflowers, a rectangular field of freshly tilled warm brown soil with neat horizontal furrows, a calm pale blue-green stream with soft ripples and grassy banks crossing the image, a winding ochre packed-earth path with small pebbles, one round leafy tree seen from above with its trunk base visible and one mossy grey boulder, both casting soft violet shadows to the right; no horizon, no sky, no diorama, no isometric block, no cut-away soil edges. No people, no text, no letters, no border.
